cosplay.character: the Chosen Undead in Elite Knight armour

cuts.head: tilt
cuts.ofreeRecent: a Han-era workshop beside a smithy — adjusts a small mechanism on the work surface with a small screwdriver; a Korean jjimjilbang hall with heated floors and sleeping mats — dries her hair with a towel; the open deck of a wooden sightseeing boat on the Yangtze — standing; the back seat of a taxi at night — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; a club powder room with a lit mirror and neon on the tiles — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — standing; a narrow path through a tall bamboo grove — standing; a candlelit gala dinner hall — holds a cup in both hands; a restored wooden plank road bolted to a sheer cliff in Sichuan — holds a white feather fan in both hands in front of her chest; a starship galley and mess hall — standing close to a high shelf or line; her living room with a deep sofa — holds a folded cleaning cloth at chest height; a moonlit lotus pond with stepping stones and glowing fireflies — holds her keepsake at chest height; a wooden river dock above calm water — rests a fishing rod against her shoulder
